axes.finite_output_equivalence: Same output on the enumerated domain only; negative needs an input/output witness.
axes.local_mechanism_sharing: Explicit shared mechanism boundary and adapters with preservation evidence; output inequality is not negative evidence.
axes.responsibility_placement: Directed implementation-to-owner assertion requiring an identified normative source; existing placement is not correctness.

label_policy: Replay finite labels only; all local-mechanism labels unknown; responsibility not assessed. No optimization desirability labels.
external_sampling: Fixed committed trees; all tracked .rs blobs inventoried; four per repository by SHA256('relation-validation-v1:' + revision + ':' + path), no result/semantic filtering; not benchmark cases yet.
lineage_policy: Exact file SHA256 compared against frozen xkernel corpus; absence of identical files does not prove independence. All external sources pending lineage and prior-exposure audit, not heldout.
stop: Replay all28 finite relations with independent unequal witnesses, preserve unknown mechanisms, inventory three fixed repositories and deterministic source selections. No source code execution or clone-effectiveness claims.
